correctness.rationale: Boole dual discriminant degree and elementary hyperplane-intersection degree are correct. Their ratio (n+1)(1-1/e)^n is strictly increasing in e; coprimality forces e=2 and n=1 at equality. Substituting x=log(n+1)/n into 1/(1-e^(-x)) proves the asymptotic with the stated remainder. Independent exact small values n=1,2,3,10,50,250 and sign of ceil(T_n) confirmed. No finite enumeration used as unrestricted proof.

The two degrees are natural, but the comparison contributes only a textbook algebraic consequence and is not separately motivated beyond rephrasing the known pair of formulas.

final_claim: For e-uple Veronese V_{n,e} over C (n>=1,e>=2), the known primal/dual degrees e^n and (n+1)(e-1)^n cross at T_n=1/(1-(n+1)^(-1/n)), with only integral equality at (1,2) and T_n=n/log(n+1)+1/2+log(n+1)/(12n)+O(log^3(n+1)/n^3).
